sentence: This project builds a conversational engagement tool with community organizations that shapes how, when and by whom AI is integrated into the city.
This project collects sediment samples after a major flood to find out how sand and mud were deposited across a forested floodplain.
This project designs small antibody fragments to replace growth factors in cell culture media.
This project tries to make cartilage from stem cells and stop the cells from turning into cells that make bone.
This project builds a virtual reality system that helps people teach several robots to work together with human workers in factories.
This project tests whether common ways of measuring forest carbon miss how much carbon undisturbed forests take up from the atmosphere.
This project builds robots guided by magnets that can move through narrow, tightly curving spaces without damaging delicate surroundings.
This project builds sensors that give off light only when they bind a target protein, to watch protein levels change in live cells in real time.
This project studies the mathematical structures that describe symmetry in quantum physics and looks for examples of them.
This project studies how to make training data for systems that process vision and language so they work more reliably.
This project teaches robots to explore objects by touch so they can sense properties such as hardness, texture, and slipperiness.
This project designs miniature soft robots made from materials that are safe for living things and the environment and that move in several ways.
This project gets a tunable laser to study how light interacts with quantum defects and two-dimensional materials.
This project uses several telescopes and the quantum nature of light to image the surfaces of bright stars in fine detail.
This project builds AI models that turn spectral signals from unknown molecules into descriptions of their structures.
This project builds an electrochemical sensor that continuously tracks an antibody drug and uses light to release it from the sensor.
